subject: Subscription renewal and capacity increase — billing owner & PO coordination
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Accounts Payable <accounts-payable@bluenova.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Subscription renewal and capacity increase — billing owner & PO coordination

Hi Sara / BlueNova AP team,

Thanks again for the productive renewal call yesterday. Per our discussion: BlueNova will renew the Dedicated Capacity subscription for another 12 months and add a 20% capacity uplift (additional reserved GPUs). To keep things moving on our side, I have a couple of billing asks: 

- Can you confirm the exact payor entity you want on the invoice? On our side we have "BlueNova Inc." and a separate legal entity "BlueNova Holdings, LLC" — we need which one to put in the "Bill To" and on the PO.
- Please provide the PO number you will issue for the renewal + capacity add-on.
- I have attached a draft SOW and our W-9 for your procurement team. Once we have the PO we can finalize and issue a formal invoice.

Attachments (stubs): Renewal_SOW_BlueNova.pdf, BlueNova_W-9.pdf

Next steps: if you can reply with the payor entity and PO by EOD Tuesday (3 business days), Marissa on our billing team will generate the invoice. If you need Net60/Net90 instead of Net30, mention it and we can route for approval.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — happy to hop on a 15-minute call if that helps.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

From: Sara Lim <sara.lim@bluenova.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Accounts Payable <accounts-payable@bluenova.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 09:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Subscription renewal and capacity increase — billing owner & PO coordination

Hi Rafael,

Thanks — quick answers from procurement/AP: 

- Bill To entity: "BlueNova Holdings, LLC" (this is the billing entity that appears on our master PO).
- PO: we will issue PO BN-2028-779 for the renewal + capacity uplift. I'll confirm the line item coding after internal approval but you can reference BN-2028-779 in the invoice.
- Terms: standard is Net30 but procurement has asked whether Net45 is acceptable; if Redwood needs Net30 we can request a faster approval but it will take ~48 hours.
- We received the W-9 and SOW you attached — thanks.

One ask: can the invoice be issued to the Bill To above and include a separate payor contact for AP remittance email: accounts-payable@bluenova.com ? Also please include our tax ID on the invoice (I can provide if you don't have it).

Sara Lim
Procurement Manager | BlueNova Inc.
sara.lim@bluenova.com

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Lim <sara.lim@bluenova.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Subscription renewal and capacity increase — billing owner & PO coordination

Marissa / Ben — forwarding procurement reply from BlueNova. Key items: they want the invoice to be billed to BlueNova Holdings, LLC and will issue PO BN-2028-779. They prefer Net30 but procurement mentioned Net45 as standard; they said they can accelerate approval for Net30 (~48 hours).

Can we: 
1) Generate invoice to "BlueNova Holdings, LLC" referencing BN-2028-779, show PO line item for Dedicated Capacity + 20% uplift.
2) Attach Redwood's W-9 and our invoice PDF in the same email thread so AP can process quickly.
3) Confirm whether Finance can accept Net30 for this renew/upgrade or if we need a credit check/approval.

I'll loop as they confirm tax ID. If you prefer, we can issue Net45 with the ability to renegotiate credit terms later.

Rafael

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Finance Team <finance@redwood.com>, Sara Lim <sara.lim@bluenova.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Subscription renewal and capacity increase — billing owner & PO coordination

Thanks for the ping, Rafael. I can support the requested changes — here's the plan: 

- Invoice: I'll create Invoice_Redwood_2028-03-29.pdf billed to "BlueNova Holdings, LLC" and reference PO BN-2028-779. The invoice will list the base renewal SKU and a separate line item for the 20% capacity add-on.
- Tax ID: Sara, please send the exact Tax ID to include on the invoice (you can reply-all or send directly to finance@redwood.com).
- W-9: we have the W-9 on file (BlueNova_W-9.pdf) — thanks.
- Terms: Our standard on new billing entities is Net45 until underwriting confirms the account. That said, we can temporarily grant Net30 for this renewal if Ben approves. Ben — can you confirm that Sales authorizes Net30 for BlueNova? If not, I will issue Net45 and we can follow up to shorten terms once underwriting completes (typically 2–3 business days).

I'll attach the draft invoice and our W-9 to this thread once ready. ETA: I'll have the invoice posted and sent to Sara/AP by 12:30pm PT.

Marissa Cole
Billing Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
